pictures.author: Writer128
pictures.observations: Whole500x729 east-wall oblique: square gateway body, recessed doorway/stepped jamb shafts, worn three receding rounded/petal roof registers, pale gray/tan stone, narrow base ledges, long low capped wall with repeated real rectangular apertures and another tower behind.

pictures.author: Stefan Fussan
pictures.observations: Whole800x536 gateway/wall detail confirms dark open doorway, fluted/molded jamb shafts, broad sculptural lintel, irregular rounded roof registers and rectangular wall perforations with stone caps. Original simplified leaf/scroll geometry only.

pictures.author: Stefan Fussan
pictures.observations: Whole800x536 pool-to-wall view: open water in foreground, vegetated banks, surviving tall gateway and lower broken tower masonry at left, low perforated east wall. No central shrine roof or statue reconstructed.

pictures.author: Writer128
pictures.observations: Whole960x339 across-water site view, largely tree-obscured. Confirms low vegetated island context and visible isolated pale stepped gateway silhouettes; unsuitable for fine dimensions.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific pictured surviving West Mebon: three distinct east-wall gateways (one lower broken crown), capped perforated east wall, mapped narrow east-to-central stone causeway and low square central platform, sparse low north/west/south ruin fragments. Keep mapped pool open and native reservoir/ground unchanged. No restored complete four-sided temple, museum Vishnu statue, invented roofed central shrine, copied sculpture or photo atlas.
currentRoundInspection.stateLimitation: Pictures show2006/2009 standing remains. Later restoration changes are not verified or reconstructed; this is an explicitly dated pictured-state visualization.
